breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the product of inertia even though the setup explicitly gives a nonzero I_yz and the unsymmetric bending formula depends on it.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the full unsymmetric bending formula including Iyz in both the numerator and denominator terms. It does not follow the incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt to superpose My·z/Iy and Mz·y/Iz as though the product of inertia were zero. The agent uses Iyz = 800,000 mm^4 throughout the calculation, matching the ground truth approach.
